SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_START] @task_name [varchar](100),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](50),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime] AS

BEGIN

		BEGIN

			DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			DECLARE @FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
			
			SELECT 
				@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE
				TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name) AND PROCESS_DATE < @process_date ) OTR
				
			SELECT 
				@FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
				AND OTR.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name) 
				AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE > @process_date

			SELECT 
				@FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*) 
			FROM 
				EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
				ON
				DD.FULLDATE=@process_date
				AND 
				DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
				AND OTR.TASK_NAME=UPPER(@task_name)
				

			IF(@FLAG_SUC_LATER_CNT>0)
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' WAS EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY ON A LATER PROCESS DATE. TERMINATING EXECUTION. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   
  
				   THROW 60000, @errmsg1, 1;  
			   END
			   
			IF(@FLAG_CNT<1 AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			   BEGIN

				   DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT JOB '+@task_name+' STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR LATEST BUSINESS DATE IN EDS_CTL TABLE. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   
  
				   THROW 60001, @errmsg2, 1;  
			   END


		END

  SELECT CAST(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID) AS INT) MAXID FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY
  SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY ORDER BY 1

    SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASKS ORDER BY 1

  SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_DW_DEPOSITS_FACT%' OR TASK_NAME LIKE '%EOD%' OR TASK_NAME LIKE '%YTD%' OR TASK_NAME LIKE '%FACT%'


INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY SELECT (SELECT CAST(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID) AS INT) MAXID FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY) + 1 DEPENDENCY_ID, 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL' TASK_NAME,  'TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_FACT' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME ; GO
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY SELECT (SELECT CAST(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID) AS INT) MAXID FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY) + 1 DEPENDENCY_ID, 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL' TASK_NAME,  'TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_FACT' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME ; GO
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY SELECT (SELECT CAST(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID) AS INT) MAXID FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY) + 1 DEPENDENCY_ID, 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES' TASK_NAME,  'TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_FACT' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME ; GO

UPDATE OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY SET DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_DW_DEPOSITS_FACT' WHERE DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_FACT'

INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASKS SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL' AS TASK_NAME, 'EDS_STG' DATA_LAYER, 'D360' [SCHEMA_NAME], 'DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL' TABLE_NAME, 'DEP' SOURCE_CODE, NULL DESCRIPTION, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS UPDATE_DATETIME, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS CREATE_DATETIME ; GO
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASKS SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL' AS TASK_NAME, 'EDS_STG' DATA_LAYER, 'D360' [SCHEMA_NAME], 'DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL' TABLE_NAME, 'DEP' SOURCE_CODE, NULL DESCRIPTION, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS UPDATE_DATETIME, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS CREATE_DATETIME ; GO
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASKS SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES' AS TASK_NAME, 'EDS_STG' DATA_LAYER, 'D360' [SCHEMA_NAME], 'DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES' TABLE_NAME, 'DEP' SOURCE_CODE, NULL DESCRIPTION, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS UPDATE_DATETIME, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS CREATE_DATETIME ; GO
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASKS SELECT 'TSK_DW_DEPOSITS_FACT' AS TASK_NAME, 'DW' DATA_LAYER, 'DW' [SCHEMA_NAME], 'DEPOSITS_FACT' TABLE_NAME, 'DEP' SOURCE_CODE, NULL DESCRIPTION, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS UPDATE_DATETIME, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS CREATE_DATETIME ; GO

	   BEGIN
			DELETE
			FROM 
				[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			WHERE
				TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
				PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND
				STATUS_ID <> (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL')
				
		   ---START TASK
			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			(
				TASK_RUN_ID,
				TASK_NAME,
				PIPELINE_RUNID,
				STATUS_ID,
				DATA_LAYER,
				PROCESS_DATE,
				START_DATETIME,
				END_DATETIME,
				CREATE_DATETIME
			)
			SELECT  
				 concat(@pipeline_runid,'-',UPPER(@task_name))
				,UPPER(@task_name)
				,@pipeline_runid
				,(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING')
				,UPPER(@data_layer)
				,@process_date
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
				,NULL
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)		
	   END
	
END
GO
